Defensive hardening implemented: onPointerDown stopPropagation mounted on thumbnail, sub_items table, and action buttons.
Strict coordinate validation, finite checks, and RFC 3986 URL construction eliminate NaN and injection vectors.
Queue-based timer management with synchronous flushAll() prevents unmount leaks and ghost data.
JSX automatic escaping prevents stored XSS; gesture stopPropagation prevents DND collision.
